status_vocabulary.YES: Direct evidence supports this exact capability and dimension; read the associated evidence field.
status_vocabulary.NO: Explicitly absent, unimplemented, unpublished or not accepted for this exact capability.
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: Only the stated subset is evidenced; remaining work stays open.
status_vocabulary.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Evidence inspected does not establish this dimension; not proof it never happened.
status_vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: Dimension does not apply, e.g. skipped implementation or obsolete status wording.

status_interpretation: Each dimension is independently recorded; no dimension implies the next.
PUBLISHED measures the stated capability/correction in deployed source history, not whether this candidate manifest has been committed.
A publication_commit may identify a conflicting/partial predecessor implementation; it is not proof the correction is published.
Runtime/operational entries are dated retained evidence, not new WO-01B executions or a claim of current process health.
EMPIRICALLY_QUALIFIED concerns the stated market/usefulness claim; deterministic tests and operational success do not establish it.
Classification is a set: CONTRADICTORY or MISSING may also be OPEN_CORRECTION. Counts overlap and are not a partition.
SUPERSEDED records preserve original wording/history; they are not edited source decisions.

empirical_discipline.requirement: Each requires separately governed evidence; no such inference is authorized by this manifest.

producer_advance_policy.currentness: Review is CURRENT only while its bound Probables Run equals the current authoritative Probables Run. Probables N -> Review N -> Probables N+1 makes Review N NON_CURRENT.
producer_advance_policy.already_imported: PRESERVE IMMUTABLY. Do not delete, rewrite or invalidate historical identity because the producer advanced.
producer_advance_policy.identical_replay: ALLOWED ONLY AS IDEMPOTENT REPLAY of evidence successfully imported before divergence.
batch_checks: At batch start verify selected Review alignment with current Probables.
Before persisting each not-yet-imported member re-check currentness.
Before final current-workflow publication/currentization re-check currentness.
producer_advance_during_batch: Preserve already successfully persisted members immutably.
Reject not-yet-imported members with typed producer-advanced / non-current-Review results.
Explicitly report partial completion caused by producer advancement.
A stale Review never becomes current because part of its batch completed.
producer_advance_policy.fresh_review: New Review bound to N+1 required for current operational processing; Review N is historical evidence only.
producer_advance_policy.historical_research_import: NOT AUTHORIZED; future completion needs separately governed NON_CURRENT_RESEARCH authority, never normal current-workflow import.
required_future_tests: producer advances before final batch publication/currentization
producer_advance_policy.downstream_authority: NONE: no Readiness, Promotion, Trade Construction, Risk, Entry, PAPER/LIVE or broker execution change.
